``` - **Build Backlinks Ethically**: Earn links from authoritative sites through guest posts, partnerships, or PR. Consequences of Fraudulent Manipulation** Search engines employ **machine learning** and **manual reviews** to detect violations. Penalties include: - **Manual Actions**: Google may deindex your site entirely (e.g., [this case study](https://searchengineland.com/google-manual-action-penalty-recovery-301619)). - **Algorithm Demotions**: Your site drops in rankings overnight (e.g., after a "core update"). - **Legal Risks**: Fraudulent businesses may face lawsuits for false advertising or consumer harm. **Example of a Penalty Notice**: ```json { "message": "Manual action: Unnatural links to your site", "affected_urls": ["example.com/products"], "recommended_action": "Disavow toxic backlinks using Google Disavow Tool" } ``` --- #### **4.
